turns.question: What was the median order amount in EUR for non-cancelled orders placed in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no median order amount metric available here (median_order_value_eur exists only for BigQuery, not in this environment), so I cannot give that figure. The closest metrics are average_order_value_eur (average amount of a non-cancelled order) and revenue_eur (sum of non-cancelled orders' amounts), which I can compute for September 2026 if you want either.
